observations.statement: GET /orders took about 2.4 seconds and the trace shows one order_items query per order
OrdersService.list calls getOrderItems inside a loop over orders

hypotheses.summary: OrdersService.list runs an N+1 query: it calls getOrderItems once per order inside a loop, so latency grows with the page size.
hypotheses.confidence_rationale: The trace shows many repeated order_items queries and the code shows the per-order call in a loop.

data_gaps: No query timing from the database was collected.
